armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD models from your army, it is **Afflicted** (see below).

### Contagion Range
Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle:
▪ **During the first battle round:** Contagion Range 3".
▪ **During the second battle round:** Contagion Range 6".
▪ **Third battle round onwards:** Contagion Range 9".
▪ Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

### Afflicted
During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.
▪ **Skullsquirm Blight:** Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:Benefit of Cover]** against the attack. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
▪ **Rattlejoint Ague:** Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.
▪ **Scabrous Soulrot:** Worsen the Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

**Pact of Decay:** When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.
armyRule.flavor: The Death Guard are warriors of the Plague God Nurgle. Their bloated bodies are riddled with corruption, and their mere presence causes the foe to sicken and wither in the grip of supernatural diseases while the battlefield falls to rot and ruin around them.
armyRule.name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)

enhancements.body: Biologus Putrifier only. Once per battle, after the bearer’s unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.
enhancements.flavor: Be it the eye of a Kroot or a Space Marine’s hearts, ground Ork tusk, or something unnameable wrenched from within a Tyranid’s corpse, this champion needs just one more ingredient to perfect a powerful new plague.
enhancements.name: Final Ingredient

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.
enhancements.flavor: The touch of this sorcerer’s mind upon another triggers feverish visions of abundant foulness that erupt into physical manifestations as they reach their crescendo.
enhancements.name: Visions of Virulence

enhancements.body: Plague Surgeon only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).
enhancements.flavor: This plague-saturated narthecium delivers generous doses of infernal maladies that restore life to even the most hideously mangled of Mortarion’s sons.
enhancements.name: Needle of Nurgle

enhancements.body: Lord of Poxes only. In the Declare Battle Formations step select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.
enhancements.flavor: A plague bellows fashioned by daemonic smiths in a realm of pure putrescence, this rasping device exhales an endless cloying soup of lividly glowing plague motes.
enhancements.name: Cornucophagus

rule.body: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.
rule.flavor: A spirit of competition infects Nurgle’s champions when they fight alongside one another. With each vying to outdo the others in virulence, the foes are subjected to a riotous string of nightmarish outbreaks amongst their ranks.
rule.name: Manifold Maladies

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.
stratagems.name: Grotesque Fortitude
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.flavor: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.
stratagems.name: Blessings of Filth
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.
stratagems.name: Malignance Magnified
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.flavor: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.
stratagems.name: Rabid Infusion
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.

stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
stratagems.flavor: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.
stratagems.name: Mobile Vector
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
stratagems.flavor: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.
stratagems.name: Death’s Heads
stratagems.target: One Biologus Putrifier unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.flavor: So grotesque and monstrous is this champion’s aspect that it fills the enemy with unreasoning dread simply to look upon him.
enhancements.name: Face of Death

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.
enhancements.flavor: A fanatical worshipper of Nurgle and a talented orator, this champion can infect their followers with the urgent need to forge into battle and spread the Plague God’s blessings to all.
enhancements.name: Vile Vigour

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: By invoking the power of this ancient talisman, the bearer can rot a sagging rent in reality and step through the Warp to burst forth elsewhere amidst a gushing sluice of foul fluids.
enhancements.name: Warprot Talisman

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".
enhancements.flavor: This armoured helm was crafted by the Daemon Prince Vermifulgus the Pestilent and carries his squirming enchantments. It manifests its wearer's will as roaring swarms of plump flies that whirl about their creator like an occluding shroud or descend on the foe to blind eyes, clog sensors and spread revolted panic.
enhancements.name: Helm of the Fly King

rule.body: In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
rule.flavor: The plagues and parasites to which these elite warriors play host are amongst the most lethal in the galaxy. Moment by moment, even the most resilient foes sicken and wither in their presence until all that remains is rotted matter deliquescing sloppily from mouldering bones.
rule.name: Deadly Vectors

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.
stratagems.name: Grim Reapers
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.
stratagems.name: Signal Pox
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.
stratagems.name: Blooming Pestilence
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.
stratagems.name: Undying Spite
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.
stratagems.name: Mortarion’s Teachings
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.flavor: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.
stratagems.name: Sickening Impact
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.
enhancements.flavor: Peering at the world through this bloated yellow orb, the bearer of this vile gift sees the souls of the sickened burning bright as targeting flares no matter how their victims try to hide.
enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon.
enhancements.flavor: This foul sorcerer has been blessed with a unique affliction that allows them to inflate their body like a repulsive bellows before vomiting forth a pressurised torrent of filth that would do any Great Unclean One proud.
enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.
enhancements.flavor: This daemonic familiar lives in the champion’s flesh and watches with bitter paranoia for enemy threats. Should it spot a counterattack from the foe, it bursts forth to scream its shrill warning.
enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar

enhancements.body: Lord of Virulence only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those VEHICLE units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has gained greater control of the vile fumes that billow from their armour, willing them forward like coiling tentacles to wreathe targets and guide in the fire of allied war engines.
enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions

rule.body:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.
▪ **Incursion:** 1 unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 units.
rule.flavor: In the wake of preparatory bombardment by artillery weapons both forbidden and foul, the surviving foe are left reeling amidst clouds of plague smog. With their flesh running like tallow and their weapons rusting in their hands, they will be hard-pressed to fight back.
rule.name: Miasmic Bombardment

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.
stratagems.name: Drawn to Despair
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.flavor: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.
stratagems.name: Font of Filth
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
stratagems.flavor: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.
stratagems.name: Blighted Land
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.
stratagems.flavor: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.
stratagems.name: Stinking Mire
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.flavor: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.
stratagems.name: Eyestinger Storm
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.
stratagems.name: Relentless Grind
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

enhancements.body: Noxious Blightbringer only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.
enhancements.flavor: This sinister artefact emits a reedy dirge to which Poxwalkers seem drawn and by whose mournful notes they appear energised and lent an echo of purpose.
enhancements.name: Witherbone Pipes

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. If the bearer is leading a Poxwalker unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.
enhancements.flavor: Gifted by Nurgle to be forever surrounded by shambling packs of Poxwalkers, this champion has become adept at leading their festering hordes into battle.
enhancements.name: Lord of the Walking Pox

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer’s unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer’s unit are destroyed.
enhancements.flavor: Parasitising the miserable scraps of soul within nearby Poxwalkers allows this sorcerer to belch even more malignant clouds of murderous foulness.
enhancements.name: Sorrowsyphon

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of Poxwalkers models in that unit.
enhancements.flavor: This mould-furred talisman is studded with teeth torn from Poxwalkers’ jaws. It bolsters the creatures’ putrid vitality, forcing them to stagger and fight even through grotesque wounds.
enhancements.name: Talisman of Burgeoning

rule.body:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new Poxwalkers unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.

BATTLE ROUNDS
▪ **Incursion:** 2, 3.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2, 3, 4.
▪ **Onslaught:** 2, 3, 4, 5.
rule.flavor: No matter how many Poxwalkers the enemy gun down or tear limb-from-limb at close quarters, more groaning mutants keep coming from every side.
rule.name: Numberless Horde

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.
stratagems.name: Gnawing Hunger
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
stratagems.flavor: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.
stratagems.name: Grip of the Walking Pox
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
stratagems.flavor: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.
stratagems.name: Shambling Wall
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.flavor: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.
stratagems.name: Shock and Horror
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.flavor: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.
stratagems.name: Hidden Amongst the Dead
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.
stratagems.name: Smeared with Filth
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".
enhancements.flavor: This unclean gift infects its host with animaluminescent fungus. Once their spirit is riddled with incorporeal mycelia, it begins to glow. This sickly radiance acts like a guiding lantern to the daemons of Nurgle, who follow its glare into realspace.
enhancements.name: Beckoning Blight

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.
enhancements.flavor: This repugnant daemon weapon extrudes swaying tendrils with lamprey maws to strike at the foe.
enhancements.name: Fell Harvester

enhancements.body: Great Unclean One only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
enhancements.flavor: Every booming peal of this cursed bell spreads rot, lesions and buboes across the foes’ bodies, sending them fleeing in terror and disgust.
enhancements.name: Entropic Knell

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a Battleline unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).
enhancements.flavor: The slurred and vomit-wet incantations from this malodorous tome bolster Nurgle’s daemons.
enhancements.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings

rule.body:
While a Plague Legions unit from your army is within 7" of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, that PLAGUE LEGIONS unit has the Nurgle’s Gift ability.

While a Death Guard unit from your army is within 7" of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, add 3" to that DEATH GUARD units Contagion Range.
rule.flavor: Reality rings like a struck bell as it rebels against the sheer wrongness of Nurgle’s daemons. Borne upon these jarring waves of metaphysical disease, magnified and redoubled with every dolorous peal, the Plague God’s myriad infections spread and multiply all the faster.
rule.name: Reverberant Rancidity

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.
stratagems.name: Clutching Corruption
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.
stratagems.name: Persistent Pests
stratagems.target: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.flavor: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.
stratagems.name: All is Rot
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.
stratagems.name: Fleshy Avalanche
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.
stratagems.name: Avatars of Decay
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
stratagems.flavor: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.
stratagems.name: Mireslick
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
enhancements.flavor: Be it the Seeping Blade, the Talon of Befoulment or even the dreaded Axe of Putrescence, this weapon contains a malevolent daemonic entity whose mere touch rots and sickens the foe.
enhancements.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
enhancements.flavor: This champion’s body blazes with fever as a cornucopia of supernatural diseases churn and roil within. Mere proximity to them is enough to trigger an infectious outbreak of daemonic viruses.
enhancements.name: Furnace of Plagues

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: The unfettered energies of Nurgle’s realm gush from the Warp like foulness from a punctured boil, earthing themselves in the fabric of realspace through this champions repulsive body.
enhancements.name: Arch Contaminator

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
enhancements.flavor: The more wounds blasted and gouged into this champion’s flesh, the more clotted matter, squirming vermin and gangrenous slime spurt forth to coagulate and seal the most grievous hurts.
enhancements.name: Revolting Regeneration

rule.body: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**. Until you lose control of that **objective**, while an enemy unit is within range of that **objective**, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
rule.flavor: As the foul tendrils of the Death Guard quest further across the battlefield, they infest even the most secure, holy and heavily warded sites with supernatural disease. To fight amidst such foulness is a virtual death sentence to the foe, win or lose.
rule.name: Worldblight

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.
stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.flavor: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.
stratagems.name: Plaguesurge
stratagems.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
stratagems.flavor: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.
stratagems.name: Leechspore Eruption
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.

stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.flavor: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
stratagems.flavor: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.
stratagems.name: Overwhelming Generosity
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.
stratagems.name: Creeping Blight
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

enhancements.body: CONTAGION ENGINE unit only. When this unit has fought, one model in this unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** D3 wounds.
enhancements.flavor: The diseased suffering inflicted by this war machine establishes an empyric barb in its victims through which it feasts, its bloated form pulsing with new growth after every attack.
enhancements.name: Parasitic Woe-reaper

enhancements.body: Friendly HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.
enhancements.flavor: Proximity to this infected mass destabilises reality, with even fortress walls bubbling and rupturing in its presence until a bubo-riddled sore forms, which it pierces like a monstrous, rusted lancet.
enhancements.name: Lancet of the Worldsore

rule.body:
▪ Friendly FOETID BLOAT-DRONE/FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER/HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE.
▪ Friendly CONTAGION ENGINE units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
rule.flavor: For all their slow degeneration, many of the Death Guard’s war machines are augmented with a fevered and inexorable urgency that brings their corrupted weapons to bear upon the foe all too quickly.
rule.name: Warped and Rusted Animus

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.flavor: As if drawn to flesh and matter yet to be blessed by corruption, infected weapons unerringly find their mark.
stratagems.name: Fresh Vectors
stratagems.target: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.
stratagems.flavor: Warp-tainted saturation oozes through this aggressive vehicle, leeching into its weapons, which spit the infection into foes at a distance.
stratagems.name: Bloodrust Deluge
stratagems.target: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect:
When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
▪ On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
▪ On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.flavor: As courage crumbles in the face of mechanised abhorrence, then does the bloom of soulrot find purchase to spread its cyclic infection.
stratagems.name: Soulrot Flux
stratagems.target: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

enhancements.body: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. When this unit’s attacks target a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit, those attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
enhancements.flavor: The buzzing swarms respond to the will of Nurgle’s disciples, sweeping down upon their chosen target, their crawling, biting and droning enfeebling the horrified foe.
enhancements.name: Insectile Murmuration

enhancements.body: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
enhancements.flavor: Nurgle’s blessings manifest as a buzzing clot of darkness that falls over these diseased pilgrims, enveloping them like an enshrouding fog.
enhancements.name: Plagueveil

rule.body: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to two friendly PLAGUE MARINES units. Those units have [core:Infiltrators].
rule.flavor: A cloud of winged insects descends over Mortarion’s pathogenic sons, obscuring their malodorous ranks and shielding them from the eyes and augurs of the enemy. Beneath thrumming storms of fat-bodied flies, Plague Marines stride towards their wavering foes until they are close enough to unleash punishing volleys of killing fire.
rule.name: Verminous Haze

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.
stratagems.flavor: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.
stratagems.name: Nauseating Paroxysms
stratagems.target: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:
▪ Can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ That target a unit within half range, can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.flavor: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.
stratagems.name: Droning Horror
stratagems.target: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
stratagems.flavor: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point-blank fire into their tormented foes.
stratagems.name: Eye of the Swarm
stratagems.target: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
enhancements.flavor: With a hacking prayer to Nurgle, this warrior can call upon a swarm of plague mites. Buzzing clumps of diseased flies and writhing waves of squirming things settle upon the bloated forms of the Death Guard and vomit streams of rejuvenating contagion into festering wounds.
enhancements.name: Rejuvenating Swarm

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle's Gift (see Codex: Death Guard). Enemy units within Contagion Range of this unit also have the effect of that Plague __in addition__ to your army's chosen Plague until the end of the battle.
enhancements.flavor: One plague is never enough for this champion, and their repulsive form is a vessel for a mutated and semi-sentient disease capable of manifesting in varied contagious forms.
enhancements.name: Host of the Hybridised Pox

rule.body: Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" to their Contagion Range (to a maximum of 12").
rule.flavor: The rancid champions of the Death Guard are blessed with the most virulent contagions of Nurgle, supernatural strains that radiate towards unwilling hosts in floods of foulness.
rule.name: Hypervirulent Strains

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: The intensive contagions that flow in abundance from this champion taint everything around them, making taking ground from them a repulsive prospect for the enemy.
stratagems.name: Territorial Infection
stratagems.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: There is no hiding from contagion, and particular pathogens can incite neurological paroxysms that force their victims to give away their positions in painful throes.
stratagems.name: Aggravus Spasms
stratagems.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:action:Action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.
stratagems.flavor: The worst infections spread both visibly and subtly. Thus do the Death Guard’s champions attack, ordering vile operations, the two vectors more deadly than either alone.
stratagems.name: Simultaneous Contamination
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit **[gloss:action:starts an Action]**.

armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD models from your army, it is **Afflicted** (see below).

### Contagion Range
Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle:
▪ **During the first battle round:** Contagion Range 3".
▪ **During the second battle round:** Contagion Range 6".
▪ **Third battle round onwards:** Contagion Range 9".
▪ Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

### Afflicted
During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.
▪ **Skullsquirm Blight:** Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:Benefit of Cover]** against the attack. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
▪ **Rattlejoint Ague:** Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.
▪ **Scabrous Soulrot:** Worsen the Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

**Pact of Decay:** When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.
armyRule.flavor: The Death Guard are warriors of the Plague God Nurgle. Their bloated bodies are riddled with corruption, and their mere presence causes the foe to sicken and wither in the grip of supernatural diseases while the battlefield falls to rot and ruin around them.
armyRule.name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)

enhancements.body: Biologus Putrifier only. Once per battle, after the bearer’s unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.
enhancements.flavor: Be it the eye of a Kroot or a Space Marine’s hearts, ground Ork tusk, or something unnameable wrenched from within a Tyranid’s corpse, this champion needs just one more ingredient to perfect a powerful new plague.
enhancements.name: Final Ingredient

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.
enhancements.flavor: The touch of this sorcerer’s mind upon another triggers feverish visions of abundant foulness that erupt into physical manifestations as they reach their crescendo.
enhancements.name: Visions of Virulence

enhancements.body: Plague Surgeon only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).
enhancements.flavor: This plague-saturated narthecium delivers generous doses of infernal maladies that restore life to even the most hideously mangled of Mortarion’s sons.
enhancements.name: Needle of Nurgle

enhancements.body: Lord of Poxes only. In the Declare Battle Formations step select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.
enhancements.flavor: A plague bellows fashioned by daemonic smiths in a realm of pure putrescence, this rasping device exhales an endless cloying soup of lividly glowing plague motes.
enhancements.name: Cornucophagus

rule.body: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.
rule.flavor: A spirit of competition infects Nurgle’s champions when they fight alongside one another. With each vying to outdo the others in virulence, the foes are subjected to a riotous string of nightmarish outbreaks amongst their ranks.
rule.name: Manifold Maladies

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.
stratagems.name: Grotesque Fortitude
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.flavor: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.
stratagems.name: Blessings of Filth
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.
stratagems.name: Malignance Magnified
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.flavor: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.
stratagems.name: Rabid Infusion
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.

stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
stratagems.flavor: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.
stratagems.name: Mobile Vector
stratagems.sublabel: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
stratagems.flavor: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.
stratagems.name: Death’s Heads
stratagems.target: One Biologus Putrifier unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.flavor: So grotesque and monstrous is this champion’s aspect that it fills the enemy with unreasoning dread simply to look upon him.
enhancements.name: Face of Death

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.
enhancements.flavor: A fanatical worshipper of Nurgle and a talented orator, this champion can infect their followers with the urgent need to forge into battle and spread the Plague God’s blessings to all.
enhancements.name: Vile Vigour

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: By invoking the power of this ancient talisman, the bearer can rot a sagging rent in reality and step through the Warp to burst forth elsewhere amidst a gushing sluice of foul fluids.
enhancements.name: Warprot Talisman

enhancements.body: Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".
enhancements.flavor: This armoured helm was crafted by the Daemon Prince Vermifulgus the Pestilent and carries his squirming enchantments. It manifests its wearer's will as roaring swarms of plump flies that whirl about their creator like an occluding shroud or descend on the foe to blind eyes, clog sensors and spread revolted panic.
enhancements.name: Helm of the Fly King

rule.body: In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
rule.flavor: The plagues and parasites to which these elite warriors play host are amongst the most lethal in the galaxy. Moment by moment, even the most resilient foes sicken and wither in their presence until all that remains is rotted matter deliquescing sloppily from mouldering bones.
rule.name: Deadly Vectors

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.
stratagems.name: Grim Reapers
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.
stratagems.name: Signal Pox
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.
stratagems.name: Blooming Pestilence
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.
stratagems.name: Undying Spite
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.
stratagems.name: Mortarion’s Teachings
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.flavor: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.
stratagems.name: Sickening Impact
stratagems.sublabel: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.
enhancements.flavor: Peering at the world through this bloated yellow orb, the bearer of this vile gift sees the souls of the sickened burning bright as targeting flares no matter how their victims try to hide.
enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon.
enhancements.flavor: This foul sorcerer has been blessed with a unique affliction that allows them to inflate their body like a repulsive bellows before vomiting forth a pressurised torrent of filth that would do any Great Unclean One proud.
enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.
enhancements.flavor: This daemonic familiar lives in the champion’s flesh and watches with bitter paranoia for enemy threats. Should it spot a counterattack from the foe, it bursts forth to scream its shrill warning.
enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar

enhancements.body: Lord of Virulence only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those VEHICLE units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has gained greater control of the vile fumes that billow from their armour, willing them forward like coiling tentacles to wreathe targets and guide in the fire of allied war engines.
enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions

rule.body:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.
▪ **Incursion:** 1 unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 units.
rule.flavor: In the wake of preparatory bombardment by artillery weapons both forbidden and foul, the surviving foe are left reeling amidst clouds of plague smog. With their flesh running like tallow and their weapons rusting in their hands, they will be hard-pressed to fight back.
rule.name: Miasmic Bombardment

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.
stratagems.name: Drawn to Despair
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.flavor: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.
stratagems.name: Font of Filth
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
stratagems.flavor: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.
stratagems.name: Blighted Land
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.
stratagems.flavor: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.
stratagems.name: Stinking Mire
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.flavor: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.
stratagems.name: Eyestinger Storm
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.
stratagems.name: Relentless Grind
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

enhancements.body: Noxious Blightbringer only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.
enhancements.flavor: This sinister artefact emits a reedy dirge to which Poxwalkers seem drawn and by whose mournful notes they appear energised and lent an echo of purpose.
enhancements.name: Witherbone Pipes

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. If the bearer is leading a Poxwalker unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.
enhancements.flavor: Gifted by Nurgle to be forever surrounded by shambling packs of Poxwalkers, this champion has become adept at leading their festering hordes into battle.
enhancements.name: Lord of the Walking Pox

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer’s unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer’s unit are destroyed.
enhancements.flavor: Parasitising the miserable scraps of soul within nearby Poxwalkers allows this sorcerer to belch even more malignant clouds of murderous foulness.
enhancements.name: Sorrowsyphon

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of Poxwalkers models in that unit.
enhancements.flavor: This mould-furred talisman is studded with teeth torn from Poxwalkers’ jaws. It bolsters the creatures’ putrid vitality, forcing them to stagger and fight even through grotesque wounds.
enhancements.name: Talisman of Burgeoning

rule.body:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new Poxwalkers unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.

BATTLE ROUNDS
▪ **Incursion:** 2, 3.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2, 3, 4.
▪ **Onslaught:** 2, 3, 4, 5.
rule.flavor: No matter how many Poxwalkers the enemy gun down or tear limb-from-limb at close quarters, more groaning mutants keep coming from every side.
rule.name: Numberless Horde

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.
stratagems.name: Gnawing Hunger
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
stratagems.flavor: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.
stratagems.name: Grip of the Walking Pox
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
stratagems.flavor: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.
stratagems.name: Shambling Wall
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.flavor: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.
stratagems.name: Shock and Horror
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.flavor: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.
stratagems.name: Hidden Amongst the Dead
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.
stratagems.name: Smeared with Filth
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".
enhancements.flavor: This unclean gift infects its host with animaluminescent fungus. Once their spirit is riddled with incorporeal mycelia, it begins to glow. This sickly radiance acts like a guiding lantern to the daemons of Nurgle, who follow its glare into realspace.
enhancements.name: Beckoning Blight

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.
enhancements.flavor: This repugnant daemon weapon extrudes swaying tendrils with lamprey maws to strike at the foe.
enhancements.name: Fell Harvester

enhancements.body: Great Unclean One only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
enhancements.flavor: Every booming peal of this cursed bell spreads rot, lesions and buboes across the foes’ bodies, sending them fleeing in terror and disgust.
enhancements.name: Entropic Knell

enhancements.body: Malignant Plaguecaster only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a Battleline unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).
enhancements.flavor: The slurred and vomit-wet incantations from this malodorous tome bolster Nurgle’s daemons.
enhancements.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings

rule.body:
While a Plague Legions unit from your army is within 7" of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, that PLAGUE LEGIONS unit has the Nurgle’s Gift ability.

While a Death Guard unit from your army is within 7" of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, add 3" to that DEATH GUARD units Contagion Range.
rule.flavor: Reality rings like a struck bell as it rebels against the sheer wrongness of Nurgle’s daemons. Borne upon these jarring waves of metaphysical disease, magnified and redoubled with every dolorous peal, the Plague God’s myriad infections spread and multiply all the faster.
rule.name: Reverberant Rancidity

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.
stratagems.name: Clutching Corruption
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.
stratagems.name: Persistent Pests
stratagems.target: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.flavor: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.
stratagems.name: All is Rot
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.flavor: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.
stratagems.name: Fleshy Avalanche
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.flavor: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.
stratagems.name: Avatars of Decay
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
stratagems.flavor: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.
stratagems.name: Mireslick
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
enhancements.flavor: Be it the Seeping Blade, the Talon of Befoulment or even the dreaded Axe of Putrescence, this weapon contains a malevolent daemonic entity whose mere touch rots and sickens the foe.
enhancements.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
enhancements.flavor: This champion’s body blazes with fever as a cornucopia of supernatural diseases churn and roil within. Mere proximity to them is enough to trigger an infectious outbreak of daemonic viruses.
enhancements.name: Furnace of Plagues

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: The unfettered energies of Nurgle’s realm gush from the Warp like foulness from a punctured boil, earthing themselves in the fabric of realspace through this champions repulsive body.
enhancements.name: Arch Contaminator

enhancements.body: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
enhancements.flavor: The more wounds blasted and gouged into this champion’s flesh, the more clotted matter, squirming vermin and gangrenous slime spurt forth to coagulate and seal the most grievous hurts.
enhancements.name: Revolting Regeneration

rule.body: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**. Until you lose control of that **objective**, while an enemy unit is within range of that **objective**, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
rule.flavor: As the foul tendrils of the Death Guard quest further across the battlefield, they infest even the most secure, holy and heavily warded sites with supernatural disease. To fight amidst such foulness is a virtual death sentence to the foe, win or lose.
rule.name: Worldblight

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.
stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.flavor: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.
stratagems.name: Plaguesurge
stratagems.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
stratagems.flavor: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.
stratagems.name: Leechspore Eruption
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.

stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.flavor: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
